descriptions: As your timer ticks to zero, only just for a moment, you see a flash of light before dying.
The supernova eradicates the solar system.
supernova.question: Maybe it could've ended differently?

1: The game went back to title screen.

descriptions: You stop over a planet to let your engines cool.
planet.question: Its uneventful, but the view is beautiful.

descriptions: While you stop over the planet, a radio transmission comes through your PDA.
An unfamiliar feline creature in a space suit stares back at you through the video feed, speaking in its foreign dialect.
red_cat.question: What will you do?

0.99: You try to interpret the high pitched cries and low growls the creature throws at you, but to no avail. Disheartened and short on time, you disconnect from the frequency and leave the creature.
0.01: Meow meow meow meow meow meow meow, meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow meow.

1: The harsh tones of the big cat are cut as you change radio frequencies and engage your thrusters, not even attempting to understand what they are saying.

Using the translator you were given earlier, you are easily able to understand the language of the creature staring expectantly at you. They give a set of coordinates and somehow you feel strongly compelled to rescue them. They come bearing a gift. [Thruster Added]
The harsh tones of the big cat are cut as you change radio frequencies and engage your thrusters, not even attempting to understand what they are saying.

descriptions: Many abandoned ships sit idly before you.
There could be plenty of useful spare parts in those ships, though navigating through them would not be easy.
ghost_fleet.question: What will you do?

0.5: The ships are full of salvageable resources, but no trace of the people they belonged to. [Fuel - 1, Repair Scrap Added]
Despite your best efforts, anything aboard the ships you might have found useful was destroyed. Not wanting to encounter whatever did this, you quickly leave. [Fuel - 1]

1: Something about those ships sends a shiver down your spine. You let your engine cool and promptly leave.

descriptions: A lone satellite drifts past your ship pulling an inactive maintenance robot along by its tether.
You could probably reach it, but it seems to be unpredictably changing trajectory periodically.
robot.question: What will you do?

0.5: One of the satellite thrusters unexpectedly fires, propelling it towards your hull. It glances off leaving some damage, but you are able to grab the robot. Sadly, it’s unoperational and you are forced to scrap it for parts. [Fuel - 1, Ship Damage, Repair Scrap Added]

Thanks to some quick maneuvering you narrowly avoid hitting the satellite and are barely able to grab the robot, but unable to get it in working order, you are forced to scrap it. [Fuel - 2, Repair Scrap Added]
You attempt to pull away from the strange satellite, but it quickly changes trajectory as you are coasting beside it and you are unable to avoid it. [Ship Damage]

descriptions: While you let your engine cool, you see an astronaut drifting uncontrollably through space with a broken tether hooked to their suit.
You can not tell if they are dead or alive.
stranded.question: What will you do?

0.5: You engage your thrusters and intercept the astronaut, managing to pull them aboard. They are unconscious, but you are able to resuscitate them. [Fuel - 1, Translator Added]
Not wanting to risk the extra fuel, you abandon the astronaut.
